GRAPH_COMPLETION.sql_skeleton:
WITH OMSSystemsAndMarketplaces AS (
    -- Amazon OMS
    SELECT DISTINCT
        'Amazon OMS' AS oms_system_name,
        'Amazon' AS connected_marketplace
    FROM
        zs_observe.amazon_oms
    WHERE
        group_level_id = '22'
        AND is_active = true -- Inferred filter

    UNION ALL

    -- Myntra OMS
    SELECT DISTINCT
        'Myntra OMS' AS oms_system_name,
        'Myntra' AS connected_marketplace
    FROM
        zs_observe.myntra_oms
    WHERE
        group_level_id = '22'
        -- AND is_active = true -- Excluded based on rule.myntra.oms_no_is_active

    UNION ALL

    -- Unicommerce OMS and its various sales channels (marketplaces)
    SELECT DISTINCT
        'Unicommerce OMS' AS oms_system_name,
        sales_channel AS connected_marketplace
    FROM
        zs_observe.unicommerce
    WHERE
        group_level_id = '22'
        AND is_active = true -- Inferred filter

    UNION ALL

    -- Increff OMS/WMS and its various sales channels (marketplaces)
    SELECT DISTINCT
        'Increff OMS/WMS' AS oms_system_name,
        sales_channel AS connected_marketplace -- Inferred column name
    FROM
        zs_observe.increff_sales
    WHERE
        group_level_id = '22'
        AND is_active = true -- Inferred filter

    UNION ALL

    -- Shopify D2C OMS
    SELECT DISTINCT
        'Shopify OMS' AS oms_system_name,
        'Shopify' AS connected_marketplace -- Inferred as the primary channel for Shopify OMS
    FROM
        zs_observe.shopify_oms
    WHERE
        group_level_id = '22'
        AND is_active = true -- Inferred filter
)
SELECT
    oms_system_name,
    connected_marketplace
FROM
    OMSSystemsAndMarketplaces
WHERE connected_marketplace IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    oms_system_name, connected_marketplace;
